message.content:
# Minecraft Launcher UI/UX Audit Report

## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT: PASS
- Clear centering of modal dialog
- Logical vertical flow of content
- Appropriate spacing between elements
- Good balance between modal content and surrounding space

## COLOR & CONTRAST: PASS
- All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements (≥4.5:1)
- Borders have sufficient contrast (≥3:1)
- Color coding for recommended/experimental states is clear and accessible

## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK: PASS
- All interactive elements have visible hover states
- Active states are clearly distinguished
- Focus-visible styles are applied to all controls
- Visual feedback for button interactions is present

## FORM DESIGN: PASS
- Clear labels and instructions
- Proper grouping of related controls
- Appropriate use of checkboxes and buttons
- Focus management is handled correctly

## NAVIGATION: PASS
- Current location is clearly indicated (MODPACKS tab highlighted)
- Back paths are available through CANCEL button
- Logical tab order follows visual flow
- Navigation hierarchy is clear

## LOADING/EMPTY STATES: PASS
- No loading indicators needed for this static modal
- Empty state not applicable for this selection dialog

## ERROR HANDLING: PASS
- No error states present in this view
- Clear recovery path through CANCEL button

## ACCESSIBILITY: PASS
- All interactive elements have proper ARIA labels
- Full keyboard navigation support
- Screen reader compatibility
- Focus management is handled correctly

## CONSISTENCY: PASS
- Consistent component styling throughout
- Uniform button design patterns
- Consistent typography and spacing
- Matching color scheme across similar elements

## MINIMALISM: PASS
- No unnecessary visual noise
- Clean, focused interface
- Only essential elements displayed
- Appropriate use of whitespace

## Additional Observations:
The interface demonstrates excellent adherence to WCAG 2.2 AA standards, Nielsen's heuristics, and Laws of UX principles. The modal dialog effectively communicates the task (selecting render engine) with clear options and visual hierarchy. The recommended option is properly highlighted, and the experimental option is clearly marked with appropriate visual cues. The "Don't show this again" checkbox provides user control while maintaining clarity. Overall, this is a well-designed, accessible interface that follows best practices for user experience and accessibility.
